title: Sheshnag in Danger? Kashmir Rallies to Save Alpine Lake

ai.summary: A public campaign in Kashmir is gathering momentum to protect alpine lakes, particularly Sheshnag Lake, from construction activities that have sparked concerns about ecological damage. The campaign includes peaceful protests, trail runs, and an online petition with over 4,300 signatures urging authorities to halt excavation and adopt sustainable tourism practices.

facts.claim: A growing public campaign is gathering momentum in Kashmir to protect its fragile alpine lakes
facts.quote: Srinagar- From a peaceful protest on Srinagar’s Shankaracharya Hill to planned trail runs and an online petition that has garnered over 4,300 signatures, a growing public campaign is gathering momentum in Kashmir to protect its fragile alpine lakes.

facts.claim: An online petition titled 'Stop construction around Kashmir’s alpine lakes' has crossed 4,300 signatures
facts.quote: an online petition titled “Stop construction around Kashmir’s alpine lakes”, hosted on Change.org, has crossed 4,300 signatures.

facts.claim: The petition argues that road construction could damage natural habitats, increase pollution, and disturb ecological balance
facts.quote: The petition argues that road construction in the name of development and improved connectivity could damage untouched natural habitats, increase pollution and disturb the ecological balance of the region’s high-altitude lakes.

facts.claim: PDP president Mehbooba Mufti expressed alarm over reports of large-scale excavation near Sheshnag Lake
facts.quote: Mehbooba expressed alarm over reports of large-scale excavation near the lake, questioning the deployment of heavy machinery in the ecologically fragile area.

facts.claim: Kashmir’s chief cleric Mirwaiz Umar Farooq urged people to collectively raise their voice against the destruction of fragile ecological zones
facts.quote: Kashmir’s chief cleric Mirwaiz Umar Farooq, who has also signed the online petition, urged people to collectively raise their voice against what he described as the destruction of fragile ecological zones.

ai.background_note: A video showing an excavator operating near Sheshnag Lake, described as a high-risk glacial lake, circulated widely on social media, prompting objections from political parties, religious leaders, and environmentalists.
